attributes.name: access_key
attributes.description:
The access key for API operations. You can retrieve this
from the 'Security & Credentials' section of the AWS console.

attributes.name: custom_ca_bundle
attributes.description: File containing custom root and intermediate certificates. Can also be configured using the `AWS_CA_BUNDLE` environment variable. (Setting `ca_bundle` in the shared config file is not supported.)

attributes.name: ec2_metadata_service_endpoint
attributes.description: Address of the EC2 metadata service endpoint to use. Can also be configured using the `AWS_EC2_METADATA_SERVICE_ENDPOINT` environment variable.

attributes.name: ec2_metadata_service_endpoint_mode
attributes.description: Protocol to use with EC2 metadata service endpoint.Valid values are `IPv4` and `IPv6`. Can also be configured using the `AWS_EC2_METADATA_SERVICE_ENDPOINT_MODE` environment variable.

attributes.name: http_proxy
attributes.description: URL of a proxy to use for HTTP requests when accessing the AWS API. Can also be set using the `HTTP_PROXY` or `http_proxy` environment variables.

attributes.name: https_proxy
attributes.description: URL of a proxy to use for HTTPS requests when accessing the AWS API. Can also be set using the `HTTPS_PROXY` or `https_proxy` environment variables.

attributes.name: insecure
attributes.description: Explicitly allow the provider to perform "insecure" SSL requests. If omitted, default value is `false`

attributes.name: max_retries
attributes.description:
The maximum number of times an AWS API request is
being executed. If the API request still fails, an error is
thrown.

attributes.name: no_proxy
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of hosts that should not use HTTP or HTTPS proxies. Can also be set using the `NO_PROXY` or `no_proxy` environment variables.

attributes.name: profile
attributes.description:
The profile for API operations. If not set, the default profile
created with `aws configure` will be used.

attributes.name: region
attributes.description:
The region where AWS operations will take place. Examples
are us-east-1, us-west-2, etc.

attributes.name: retry_mode
attributes.description: Specifies how retries are attempted. Valid values are `standard` and `adaptive`. Can also be configured using the `AWS_RETRY_MODE` environment variable.

attributes.name: s3_us_east_1_regional_endpoint
attributes.description: Specifies whether S3 API calls in the `us-east-1` region use the legacy global endpoint or a regional endpoint. Valid values are `legacy` or `regional`. Can also be configured using the `AWS_S3_US_EAST_1_REGIONAL_ENDPOINT` environment variable or the `s3_us_east_1_regional_endpoint` shared config file parameter

attributes.name: s3_use_path_style
attributes.description:
Set this to true to enable the request to use path-style addressing,
i.e., https://s3.amazonaws.com/BUCKET/KEY. By default, the S3 client will
use virtual hosted bucket addressing when possible
(https://BUCKET.s3.amazonaws.com/KEY). Specific to the Amazon S3 service.

attributes.name: secret_key
attributes.description:
The secret key for API operations. You can retrieve this
from the 'Security & Credentials' section of the AWS console.

attributes.name: shared_config_files
attributes.description: List of paths to shared config files. If not set, defaults to [~/.aws/config].

attributes.name: shared_credentials_files
attributes.description: List of paths to shared credentials files. If not set, defaults to [~/.aws/credentials].

attributes.name: skip_credentials_validation
attributes.description: Skip the credentials validation via STS API. Used for AWS API implementations that do not have STS available/implemented.

attributes.name: skip_metadata_api_check
attributes.description: Skip the AWS Metadata API check. Used for AWS API implementations that do not have a metadata api endpoint.

attributes.name: skip_region_validation
attributes.description: Skip static validation of region name. Used by users of alternative AWS-like APIs or users w/ access to regions that are not public (yet).

attributes.name: skip_requesting_account_id
attributes.description: Skip requesting the account ID. Used for AWS API implementations that do not have IAM/STS API and/or metadata API.

attributes.name: sts_region
attributes.description:
The region where AWS STS operations will take place. Examples
are us-east-1 and us-west-2.

attributes.name: tag_policy_compliance
attributes.description: The severity with which to enforce organizational tagging policies on resources managed by this provider instance. At this time this only includes compliance with required tag keys by resource type. Valid values are "error", "warning", and "disabled". When unset or "disabled", tag policy compliance will not be enforced by the provider. Can also be configured with the TF_AWS_TAG_POLICY_COMPLIANCE environment variable.

attributes.name: token
attributes.description:
session token. A session token is only required if you are
using temporary security credentials.

attributes.name: token_bucket_rate_limiter_capacity
attributes.description: The capacity of the AWS SDK's token bucket rate limiter.

attributes.name: use_dualstack_endpoint
attributes.description: Resolve an endpoint with DualStack capability

attributes.name: use_fips_endpoint
attributes.description: Resolve an endpoint with FIPS capability

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: Product details to append to the User-Agent string sent in all AWS API calls.
